test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom from the following options that can substitute the underlined part of the given sentence.

He is __a disgrace to his family.__
solution:
The correct answer is A black sheep.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• A fish out of water- A person in a completely unsuitable environment or situation.
 
• A white elephant- Something that is expensive, or that costs a lot of money to keep in good condition, but that has no useful purpose and is no longer wanted
 
• A lone wolf- A very independent or solitary person.
 
• A black sheep- A person **who has done something bad that brings embarrassment** or shame **to his or her family**. 
 
 
 
• Hence the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the segment 'disgrace to his family' is 'a black sheep'.
